description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee leave entitlement and usage reports, including parameters such as employee number, report type, and sorting options within the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering leave entitlement and usage reports, with properties for employee number, report type, and sorting options.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getReportType
methods.description: Returns the type of report ('employee' or 'my').

methods.name: setReportType
methods.description: Sets the report type; throws exception if invalid.
